name: Additive photosensitivity risk
actions: Review concurrent agents with known photosensitivity risk.
Counsel on sun protection and avoidance of excessive ultraviolet exposure when clinically appropriate.
Monitor for exaggerated sunburn or phototoxic skin reactions.

rationale: Both drugs can contribute to photosensitivity risk.
Overlapping photosensitizing effects may increase susceptibility to phototoxic reactions.

explanation_template: {A_name} and {B_name} both contribute photosensitivity risk. Combined exposure may increase susceptibility to phototoxic skin reactions (educational).

references.citation: PD stacking: overlapping photosensitivity risk may increase phototoxic reaction risk.
